about: T1.32g's acceptance tests that failed when the independent test author wrote them, before the implementation, at 43f6bfa3 (tests/test_t132g_cell_claims.py: coverage rule 6's own seeds; tests/test_t132g_rule6_type_depth.py, at 1079af49: a nested type text read with a bound; tests/test_t132g_reference_internal_error.py, at 469c1924, for T1.32g part 2a: python-old holds the reference's own INTERNAL_ERROR, the old client's crash, recorded as such; tests/test_t132g_first_admission.py, at 469c1924, for part 2a: a first admission held to the reference as approved entries change it; tests/test_t132g_python_old_as_run.py, at f504a9e9, for part 2a's fix after its review: python-old's lines as run (tests/golden/t132g-python-old-*.jsonl), host warnings and origins left out of exactly, the checkpoint's reference line, an entry's case of another type). Part 2c (T1.32g part 2c, at f504a9e9): contract/tests/test_t132g_map_union_values.py ('exits') and rust/crates/sdm-testkit/tests/t132g_map_union_values.rs ('rust-host', vector names of contract/t132g-p2c-vectors.json): a map's and a union's canonical cells. Part 2d (T1.32g part 2d, at bc4b2d0c): tests/test_t132g_later_stage.py, on the real lines of tests/golden/t132g-later-stage: an approved entry moving a runner past the reference's stop compares only the evidence the reference produced, and large Arrow buffers predicted from the case's setup; tests/test_t132g_later_stage_moves.py, at d03f0f65, for part 2d's fix after its review: which approved entries are a move past the checkpoint reference's stop, the move held since in a baseline, and the large buffers' setting as DuckDB applies it (a later RESET or false, a base's setting); contract/tests/test_t132g_large_buffer_settings.py, at 1723e8e9, for part 2d's fix 2 after Codex's round 2: the setting's ordinary spellings held to what real DuckDB does, and an unsupported one failing by name; the same file, at c1e9b099, for part 2d's fix 4 after Codex's round 3: the strict rule, an element naming the setting exactly one canonical statement or refused by name, a SESSION or GLOBAL scope refused too. Part 2e (T1.32g part 2e, at c1c1dd21): contract/tests/test_t132g_interval_values.py ('exits') and rust/crates/sdm-testkit/tests/t132g_interval_values.rs ('rust-host', vector names of contract/t132g-p2e-vectors.json): an interval's canonical cells; part 2c's interval vector, renamed, taking the form ('exits' and 'rust-host'), its old id and name dropped from authored as no longer tests. Part 2f (T1.32g part 2f, at 9e0282ae): tests/test_t132g_later_stage_cells.py, on part 2d's real fixtures and python-old's real lines (tests/golden/t132g-later-stage/python-old.jsonl) in the dbr17-pandas2 cell: the cell's pair, python-core against python-old, compared only up to where python-old stopped under an approved move. Part 2f's fix after CI run 38668036301 (T1.32g part 2f, at 9e4d7ca6): the same file, in the floor-pandas2.2 cell, python-old's runtime DeprecationWarnings before its stop left out under HOST-5, its other warnings the first of python-core's. Each listed test must still fail (strict); the implementer takes an id out of 'pending' once it passes, and changes nothing else: 'pending' stays within 'authored', which is the test author's.
